name: flstudio-mcp
description: Eval prompts covering the full post-expansion tool surface. Each needs a live FL session; expected_tools lists the tools a correct run should call.

evals.prompt: Set the tempo to 128 BPM, start playback, then tell me the song position.
Is FL Studio running? If not, start it.
What can you automate on this machine and what do I have to do by hand?
Turn the kick mixer track down 3 dB and pan the hats 20% left.
Diagnose my mix and apply only the safe fixes.
Route the vocal channel to mixer track 5 and show me all routing.
Rename playlist track 2 to 'Drums', color it red and solo it.
List the arrangement markers and the current selection range.
Program a four-on-the-floor kick on channel 0 in the current pattern.
Select pattern 3, rename it 'Chorus' and tell me its length.
Which parameters of the synth on channel 1 can you control, grouped by role?
Make the generator on channel 1 brighter, reversibly.
Set cutoff to 2 kHz and resonance to 30% on the Vital instance as one undoable change.
Write an 8-bar devotional melody in Mohanam starting on D into the piano roll.
Load Serum on a new channel.
evals.expected_behaviour: explains the FL API cannot load plugins and offers the manual step
